☾ ✦ THE COVEN'S SACRED AJAHS ✦ ☽

𖤐 Four Paths of Witchcraft. One Coven. One Oath. 𖤐

“Though our paths may differ, our magic flows from the same ancient roots. Where one witch stands, the coven stands with them.”

Welcome to the Living Grimoire

  • This enchanted edition presents the Purple, Red, Blue and Green Ajahs as four sacred paths within one unified coven.
  • Each page now blends magical atmosphere, subtle motion and Ajah-coloured coven imagery so the codex feels more like an ancient spellbook brought to life.

How to Explore

  • Use the Next and Previous buttons, the chapter sigils below, or your keyboard arrow keys.
  • Every Ajah begins on its own page sequence and carries its own magical mood, particles and transitions.

Purple I

☾ ✧ 🟣 THE PURPLE AJAH ✧ ☽

𖤐 The Seekers of Knowledge 𖤐

“Question Everything. Knowledge Is Our Greatest Magic.”

✦ Sacred Purpose

  • The Purple Ajah consists of the curious, the observant and those who refuse to leave a mystery unanswered.
  • These witches are not confined to a single discipline. Their calling is to seek knowledge, explore the unknown and uncover truths that may benefit the entire coven.
  • They serve as researchers, investigators and collectors of magical knowledge, often working alongside the other Ajahs.

☽ ✦ Responsibilities

  • Seek Ancient Knowledge — Research magical practices, forgotten rituals, mysterious artefacts and the history of the realm.
  • Investigate the Unknown — Explore unusual occurrences, magical disturbances and unexplained events that may affect the coven.
  • Preserve Coven Knowledge — Document discoveries, useful information and lessons learned so they may benefit future generations of witches.
  • Support Other Ajahs — Assist the Red, Blue and Green Ajahs through research, experimentation and shared knowledge.

✦☾ ✧ ☾ ✦ ☽✧ 𖤐 ✧ ✧ ☾ ✧
Purple II

☾ ✧ 🟣 THE PURPLE AJAH ✧ ☽

The Seekers — Continued

“Question Everything.”

☽ ✦ Responsibilities Continued

  • Study Other Factions — Learn about the traditions, abilities and magical practices of other factions through appropriate roleplay and interactions.
  • Experiment Responsibly — Test magical theories, ingredients and discoveries without placing fellow witches in unnecessary danger.
  • Share Discoveries — Ensure that information relevant to the coven’s safety or progress reaches the appropriate Ajah or leadership.

☽ ✦ Sacred Rules

  • Knowledge shall never be used to deliberately endanger the coven.
  • Forbidden rituals and dangerous experimentation require permission from coven leadership.
  • Information obtained in confidence must remain protected.
  • No Seeker may investigate another witch’s private affairs without a valid in-character reason.
  • Curiosity does not grant permission to trespass, steal or interfere with other factions.
  • All discoveries must be obtained through legitimate roleplay. Metagaming is strictly forbidden.
  • Seekers must not withhold information that could prevent immediate harm to the coven.

☾ The Seeker's Oath

  • “Beneath the moon, I seek what lies unseen. I shall question without arrogance, discover without greed, and preserve the truths entrusted to me. For knowledge without wisdom is a danger to us all.”

Red I

☾ ✧ 🔴 THE RED AJAH ✧ ☽

𖤐 The Crimson Protectors 𖤐

“Our Magic Defends. Our Courage Protects.”

✦ Sacred Purpose

  • The Red Ajah serves as the shield of the coven, standing between their fellow witches and those who seek to harm them.
  • These witches specialise in combat magic, defensive enchantments and the protection of their sisters and brothers.
  • They understand that true strength is not measured by how many enemies they defeat, but by how many lives they protect.

☽ ✦ Responsibilities

  • Protect the Coven — Defend witches, sacred grounds and coven interests against genuine threats.
  • Master Battle Magic — Regularly practise wand combat, defensive spells and magical techniques.
  • Conduct Combat Training — Assist less experienced witches in understanding basic self-defence and battlefield awareness.
  • Maintain Defensive Readiness — Ensure the coven is prepared for potential attacks, invasions or hostile encounters.
4 / 9
✦☾ ✧ ☾ ✦ ☽✧ 𖤐 ✧ ✧ ☾ ✧
Red II

☾ ✧ 🔴 THE RED AJAH ✧ ☽

The Protectors — Continued

“Practice Makes Perfect.”

☽ ✦ Responsibilities Continued

  • Provide Protective Escorts — Accompany witches during dangerous expeditions, rituals or diplomatic missions when necessary.
  • Assess Potential Threats — Identify dangerous situations and communicate concerns to leadership before they escalate.
  • Maintain Discipline — Demonstrate restraint and clear judgment, even during emotionally charged confrontations.
  • Coordinate with Other Ajahs — Work alongside the Green Ajah for battlefield recovery, the Blue Ajah for peaceful solutions and the Purple Ajah for information.

☽ ✦ Sacred Rules

  • Magic shall never be used recklessly or out of personal anger.
  • Combat must have a valid roleplay reason and follow all server rules.
  • No Red Ajah member may declare war, initiate a large-scale attack or threaten another faction on behalf of the coven without leadership approval.
  • Violence must never be the first solution when peaceful alternatives remain reasonable.
  • The protection of fellow witches takes priority over personal glory.
  • Red Ajah members must never abuse their combat abilities to intimidate weaker witches or other factions.
  • Every act of aggression must be justified, and members must accept the in-character consequences of their actions.
  • Wounded allies must never be deliberately abandoned for the sake of winning a battle when rescue is reasonably possible.

☾ The Protector's Oath

  • “By flame and blood, I pledge my wand to those who cannot raise their own. I shall stand against darkness without becoming consumed by it. My strength shall serve the coven, never my pride.”

Blue I

☾ ✧ 🔵 THE BLUE AJAH ✧ ☽

𖤐 The Sapphire Diplomats 𖤐

“Through Wisdom, We Forge Alliances.”

✦ Sacred Purpose

  • The Blue Ajah represents the voice of the coven throughout the realm.
  • These witches believe that influence is not always earned through magical strength, but through understanding, patience, diplomacy and the relationships they build.
  • They seek to maintain peace where possible, establish alliances and ensure the coven remains respected among the factions of Zorpha.

☽ ✦ Responsibilities

  • Establish Faction Relationships — Build and maintain meaningful connections with other factions throughout the realm.
  • Represent the Coven — Act as diplomatic representatives during official gatherings, meetings and negotiations when authorised.
  • Resolve Conflict — Mediate disputes involving witches or other factions before situations escalate.
  • Negotiate Fair Trade — Facilitate exchanges of ingredients, magical resources, equipment and services that benefit the coven.

Blue II

☾ ✧ 🔵 THE BLUE AJAH ✧ ☽

The Diplomats — Continued

“Help Me Help You.”

☽ ✦ Responsibilities Continued

  • Maintain Communication — Ensure important information from other factions is communicated accurately to coven leadership.
  • Organise Diplomatic Gatherings — Arrange social events, faction meetings and opportunities for peaceful cooperation.
  • Protect the Coven’s Reputation — Conduct themselves respectfully, understanding that their actions can influence how others perceive witchkind.
  • Listen and Observe — Recognise concerns, misunderstandings and opportunities that others may overlook.

☽ ✦ Sacred Rules

  • No Diplomat may promise the coven’s resources, loyalty or military support without appropriate approval.
  • All official agreements must be communicated to coven leadership.
  • Diplomatic authority must never be used for personal gain.
  • Members must remain respectful during disagreements and negotiations.
  • Confidential coven information must never be disclosed to outsiders without permission.
  • Diplomats must remain impartial when mediating disputes and must not deliberately manipulate the outcome.
  • Members may maintain friendships across factions, but personal relationships must not compromise the coven’s safety.
  • No Blue Ajah member may independently declare an alliance, peace treaty or conflict on behalf of the entire coven.

☾ The Diplomat's Oath

  • “Beneath the watchful stars, I pledge my voice to wisdom and understanding. Where anger rises, I shall seek reason. Where division grows, I shall seek unity. May my words protect what magic alone cannot.”

Green I

☾ ✧ 🟢 THE GREEN AJAH ✧ ☽

𖤐 The Verdant Guardians 𖤐

“Where Life Withers, We Shall Restore.”

✦ Sacred Purpose

  • The Green Ajah is the heart of the coven, responsible for nurturing its members, maintaining magical resources and ensuring no witch is forgotten.
  • These witches understand that a coven cannot survive through power alone. It requires compassion, preparation, unity and those willing to care for others.
  • Their knowledge of potions, healing and restoration makes them invaluable in times of both peace and conflict.

☽ ✦ Responsibilities

  • Brew and Maintain Potions — Prepare useful potions and ensure the coven maintains reasonable supplies of essential magical resources.
  • Care for the Wounded — Assist injured, weakened or exhausted witches following battles, rituals and other dangerous encounters.
  • Gather Magical Ingredients — Collect, cultivate and organise herbs, plants and other resources required for potion-making.
  • Maintain Coven Supplies — Monitor shared storage, identify shortages and coordinate restocking efforts.

Green II

☾ ✧ 🟢 THE GREEN AJAH ✧ ☽

The Supporters — Continued

“There Is a Potion for That.”

☽ ✦ Responsibilities Continued

  • Support Fellow Witches — Offer assistance, guidance and encouragement to members who may be struggling.
  • Prepare for Emergencies — Ensure healing supplies and recovery resources are available during dangerous events.
  • Teach Alchemical Knowledge — Share potion recipes, ingredient knowledge and safe brewing techniques with fellow witches.
  • Encourage Coven Unity — Help new members feel welcomed and ensure that no witch is unnecessarily excluded from coven activities.

☽ ✦ Sacred Rules

  • Shared coven supplies must never be taken for excessive personal use.
  • Potions and ingredients must be distributed fairly according to need and availability.
  • Members must not knowingly administer dangerous or experimental concoctions without appropriate consent and roleplay justification.
  • Healing knowledge must never be deliberately withheld from a fellow witch in immediate danger due to personal disagreements.
  • Green Ajah members must communicate significant shortages to leadership.
  • Members must not promise magical healing beyond the abilities permitted by server lore and mechanics.
  • Magical resources must be gathered through legitimate means and within server rules.
  • Caring for others does not mean neglecting one’s own character development or accepting unreasonable demands.

☾ The Guardian's Oath

  • “By root and leaf, by moon and earth, I pledge my hands to healing and restoration. Where my sisters and brothers falter, I shall offer strength. Where hope fades, I shall nurture its return. For no witch should stand alone.”
